Every dish in the apple. Well, it's delicious.
Aug 2026 • Couples
We've been looking for a place that's delicious, definitely not going out and not spicy, but we found much better.

In ten days we went to a bunch of cafes and restaurants, but this one liked it best.

Many different dishes were taken: pumpkin soup, tom pit, seafood salad, beef steak, salmon under different sauces, shrimp, lobster, seafood pizza.

I liked every dish. Even when compared to different countries - this cafe is a favorite. Were in very, very different places.

Another plus is the Russian administrator Maxim, who will tell you, explain and advise you.

The price tag is above average. But it's definitely worth it.

Highly recommended.

Terrible food at inflated prices
Apr 2026 • Couples
The worst place we visited in Nha Trang is the Mediterranean and Greek restaurant Santorini, located on the first line of Changfu Street (100 Trần Phú). It looks like a luxurious building with verandas and terraces, and in fact is far from a cheap diner. We can say that we are not here of our own free will, but of hopelessness. The thing is, 90% of the establishments in Nha Trang close at 10 p.m. and we just didn't get to dinner after a walk. The so-called Santorini restaurant was in the immediate vicinity of our hotel and was open until 23.00. My dinner that ill-fated evening was a quick-cooking noodle flavored with wild spices, with three (!) pieces of vegetables and shrimp – the masterpiece was listed on the menu as "Fried Seafood Noodles." My husband was a little luckier - he got a fish with tasteless rice. It was worth an order of magnitude higher than the establishments in the neighborhood. By the way, two days later we bought exactly the same noodles at the 24-hour Circle K minimarket, but for five times the price.
